headline: Earnings Season Is Here. Will Euphoric Be Good Enough?
summary: At the end of last year, Wall Street analysts who ventured guesses on second-quarter earnings predicted 14% growth, on average.  By the end of June, analysts were predicting 22% earnings growth.  Stock market gains have lately lagged behind.
